name: image-gallery
title: Image gallery
description: A thumbnail grid that opens a lightbox with previous and next.
a11y: Each thumbnail is a button named by the image's required alt text, with aria-haspopup=dialog.
The lightbox is a modal dialog titled 'Image 2 of 5'; focus moves in, is trapped, and returns to the thumbnail on close.
ArrowLeft and ArrowRight (swapped in RTL) and the Previous and Next buttons move through the images and wrap; a horizontal swipe does the same; Escape closes.
A polite status message announces the new image's alt text and position. Neighbouring images are preloaded.
